description.text: This courseis set up for the students who wish to study Chinese language exclusively. Chinese language classes are divided into three administrative levels in accordance with students' proficiency of Chinese, namely: Elementary, Intermediate and Advanced Classes. There will be an entrance exam, according which to divide into classes. The lectures are conducted in a highly professional manner and at the same time, the extra curricula activities range from school visits to cultural and language interactions. These are designed to deepen the students' understanding of the Chinese culture, train their skills of practicing Chinese and create a sound base for their further study and future progression. After completing the course, students qualify for a certificate in Chinese proficiency.

duration.text: The Chinese Language Class at Liaoning University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1805 USD/per year ￥ 13000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: The applicant should be aged between 18 and 65 and healthy.
